findings.claim: Deliberation remains registered and expected as a bundled plugin in source-checkout runtime behavior.
findings.observed: The implementation checkpoint says src/plugins/bundled-plugin-metadata.test.ts retains the literal source-checkout startup inventory and src/plugins/source-checkout-runtime.test.ts retains real Deliberation hook and intake assertions as source-development behavior; only packaged build entries and artifacts omit Deliberation.
findings.rationale: The canonical task requires the fork to stop registering and expecting Deliberation as bundled, explicitly identifies the source-checkout onlyPluginIds deliberation registry assertion as coupling that must change, and requires empty-config gateway startup resolution to omit Deliberation from bundled startup ids. Relabeling the retained source-checkout registration does not change that behavior.
findings.required: Keep extensions/deliberation source intact, but remove Deliberation from bundled discovery/registration and bundled startup expectations in source checkouts; preserve any source-level plugin tests through direct non-bundled loading and assert the explicit-enabled missing external plugin behavior.

goals.summary: Remove deliberation from the fork's bundled plugin registration surface
